                code            TEXT NOT NULL,
                name            TEXT,
                qty             REAL,             -- 纪律仓不存股数,可空(如实留空不猜)
                sell_date       TEXT NOT NULL,    -- 实际(提前)卖出日

                entry_price     REAL,             -- 假想跟踪快照:原仓入场价
                stop_price      REAL,             -- 假想跟踪快照:原仓止损价
                entry_date      TEXT,             -- 假想跟踪快照:原仓入场日
                last_advance    TEXT,             -- 幂等守卫:同一根K线只推进一次
                rule_exit_date  TEXT,             -- 假想规则出场日(闭环时填)
                rule_exit_price REAL,

                created         TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated         TEXT NOT NULL
            )
schema.pool:
CREATE TABLE pool (
                id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                code          TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 股票代码
                name          TEXT,              -- 股票名称
                state         TEXT NOT NULL,     -- candidate/research/watchlist/holding/cooldown/removed
                first_seen    TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 首次进候选日期(ISO)
                state_since   TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 进入当前状态的日期(过期/倒计时基准)
                expire_at     TEXT,              -- 候选过期日(first_seen+10交易日,由编排层算)
                research_due  TEXT,              -- 研究中72h倒计时截止时刻
                platform_price REAL,             -- 突破平台价(止损参考)
                stop_price    REAL,              -- 当前止损价
                entry_price   REAL,              -- 实际入场价(holding 填)
                entry_date    TEXT,              -- 实际入场日
                position_amt  REAL,              -- 持仓金额(元)
                cooldown_until TEXT,             -- 冷却期截止日
                sort_score    REAL,              -- 排序分(七因子分×技术状态,池满替换建议用)
                note          TEXT,              -- 自由备注
                created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL
            , anchor_close REAL, anchor_date TEXT, strategy TEXT, industry TEXT, ladder_stage TEXT, ladder_start_date TEXT)
schema.position_books:
CREATE TABLE position_books (
                position_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                book_type   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(book_type IN ('speculative','investment')),
                origin      TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
            )
schema.position_books_no_relabel:
CREATE TRIGGER position_books_no_relabel
            BEFORE UPDATE OF book_type ON position_books
            WHEN NEW.book_type <> OLD.book_type
            BEGIN
                SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'position book label is immutable');
            END
schema.positions:
CREATE TABLE positions (
                id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                code         TEXT NOT NULL,
                name         TEXT,
                buy_date     TEXT NOT NULL,
                buy_price    REAL NOT NULL,
                stop_price   REAL,            -- 止损价(通常=平台价),规则5与盘中距止损用
                amount       REAL,            -- 买入金额(元);csv 导入的旧仓可为空,统计会提示补填
                rule_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,  -- 录入时的规则版本(统计口径切换用)
                status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',   -- open / closed
                created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
            , signal_type TEXT, strategy TEXT, industry TEXT, qty REAL)
schema.review_chats:
CREATE TABLE review_chats (
                chat_date  TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 对话所属日期(按日一会话,次日新开)
                seq        INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- 当日内消息序号
                role       TEXT NOT NULL,     -- user / assistant
                content    TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (chat_date, seq)
            )
schema.rule_changes:
CREATE TABLE rule_changes (
                id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                changed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                param      TEXT NOT NULL,
                old_value  TEXT,
                new_value  TEXT,
                reason     TEXT,
                source     TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 用户手改 / AI提案 / 恢复默认
                applied    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,   -- 1=生效 0=驳回(提案被拒也留痕)
                version    INTEGER NOT NULL    -- 生效后的规则版本号(驳回记当前版本)
            )
schema.snapshots:
CREATE TABLE snapshots (
                trade_date  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   -- 快照对应的已收盘交易日
                created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 本次筛选完成时刻
                payload     TEXT NOT NULL       -- 整份快照 JSON(index/groups/持仓提醒/失败清单等)
            )
schema.strategy_switches:
CREATE TABLE strategy_switches(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            judged_date TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            mode TEXT NOT NULL,             -- shadow(影子)/live(评审后才可能出现)
            regime TEXT NOT NULL,
            decision TEXT NOT NULL,         -- keep|would_switch
            active_card TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 现任(影子期恒=mid)
            suggest_card TEXT,              -- would_switch 时的目标卡
            reason TEXT NOT NULL,           -- 白话:为什么(无背书/带宽不足/任期未满…)
            engine_ver TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.thesis:
CREATE TABLE thesis (
                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                pool_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,    -- 关联 pool.id
                code        TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,       -- 入池/立项时刻
                content_json TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 七因子逐项+空头报告三路径(JSON)
                version     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, score_ver TEXT, evidence_n INTEGER,  -- 重做立项时版本递增
                FOREIGN KEY (pool_id) REFERENCES pool(id)
            )
schema.trades:
CREATE TABLE trades (
                id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                position_id  INTEGER,          -- 来源持仓(导入的历史交易可为空)
                code         TEXT NOT NULL,
                name         TEXT,
                buy_date     TEXT, buy_price REAL, amount REAL,
                sell_date    TEXT NOT NULL, sell_price REAL NOT NULL,
                reason       TEXT NOT NULL,    -- 止损破平台|破MA20|破前低|主动止盈|其他
                note         TEXT,             -- 一句话复盘
                pnl          REAL,             -- 盈亏金额(元);amount 缺失时为空
                pnl_pct      REAL,             -- 盈亏 %(卖价/买价-1)
                rule_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
            , signal_type TEXT, strategy TEXT, ladder_leg TEXT)

                created_at  TEXT NOT NULL

                stop_price    REAL,              -- 当前止损价
                entry_price   REAL,              -- 实际入场价(holding 填)
                entry_date    TEXT,              -- 实际入场日
                position_amt  REAL,              -- 持仓金额(元)
                cooldown_until TEXT,             -- 冷却期截止日
                sort_score    REAL,              -- 排序分(七因子分×技术状态,池满替换建议用)
                note          TEXT,              -- 自由备注
                created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL
            , anchor_close REAL, anchor_date TEXT, strategy TEXT, industry TEXT, ladder_stage TEXT, ladder_start_date TEXT)
schema.position_books:
CREATE TABLE position_books (
                position_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                book_type   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(book_type IN ('speculative','investment')),
                origin      TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
            )
schema.position_books_no_relabel:
CREATE TRIGGER position_books_no_relabel
            BEFORE UPDATE OF book_type ON position_books
            WHEN NEW.book_type <> OLD.book_type
            BEGIN
                SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'position book label is immutable');
            END
schema.positions:
CREATE TABLE positions (
                id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                code         TEXT NOT NULL,
                name         TEXT,
                buy_date     TEXT NOT NULL,
                buy_price    REAL NOT NULL,
                stop_price   REAL,            -- 止损价(通常=平台价),规则5与盘中距止损用
                amount       REAL,            -- 买入金额(元);csv 导入的旧仓可为空,统计会提示补填
                rule_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,  -- 录入时的规则版本(统计口径切换用)
                status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',   -- open / closed
                created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
            , signal_type TEXT, strategy TEXT, industry TEXT, qty REAL)
schema.review_chats:
CREATE TABLE review_chats (
                chat_date  TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 对话所属日期(按日一会话,次日新开)
                seq        INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- 当日内消息序号
                role       TEXT NOT NULL,     -- user / assistant
                content    TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (chat_date, seq)
            )
schema.rule_changes:
CREATE TABLE rule_changes (
                id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                changed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                param      TEXT NOT NULL,
                old_value  TEXT,
                new_value  TEXT,
                reason     TEXT,
                source     TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 用户手改 / AI提案 / 恢复默认
                applied    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,   -- 1=生效 0=驳回(提案被拒也留痕)
                version    INTEGER NOT NULL    -- 生效后的规则版本号(驳回记当前版本)
            )
schema.snapshots:
CREATE TABLE snapshots (
                trade_date  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   -- 快照对应的已收盘交易日
                created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 本次筛选完成时刻
                payload     TEXT NOT NULL       -- 整份快照 JSON(index/groups/持仓提醒/失败清单等)
            )
schema.strategy_switches:
CREATE TABLE strategy_switches(
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            judged_date TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            mode TEXT NOT NULL,             -- shadow(影子)/live(评审后才可能出现)
            regime TEXT NOT NULL,
            decision TEXT NOT NULL,         -- keep|would_switch
            active_card TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 现任(影子期恒=mid)
            suggest_card TEXT,              -- would_switch 时的目标卡
            reason TEXT NOT NULL,           -- 白话:为什么(无背书/带宽不足/任期未满…)
            engine_ver TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.thesis:
CREATE TABLE thesis (
                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                pool_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,    -- 关联 pool.id
                code        TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,       -- 入池/立项时刻
                content_json TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 七因子逐项+空头报告三路径(JSON)
                version     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, score_ver TEXT, evidence_n INTEGER,  -- 重做立项时版本递增
                FOREIGN KEY (pool_id) REFERENCES pool(id)
            )
schema.trades:
CREATE TABLE trades (
                id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                position_id  INTEGER,          -- 来源持仓(导入的历史交易可为空)
                code         TEXT NOT NULL,
                name         TEXT,
                buy_date     TEXT, buy_price REAL, amount REAL,
                sell_date    TEXT NOT NULL, sell_price REAL NOT NULL,
                reason       TEXT NOT NULL,    -- 止损破平台|破MA20|破前低|主动止盈|其他
                note         TEXT,             -- 一句话复盘
                pnl          REAL,             -- 盈亏金额(元);amount 缺失时为空
                pnl_pct      REAL,             -- 盈亏 %(卖价/买价-1)
                rule_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
            , signal_type TEXT, strategy TEXT, ladder_leg TEXT)
schema.user_actions:
CREATE TABLE user_actions (
                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                trade_date  TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 卡片所属日报日
                code        TEXT NOT NULL,
                action      TEXT NOT NULL,     -- skip(这次不买)/ack(看过了)/dismiss
                card_kind   TEXT,              -- 卡类型(buy/sell/trim/review/new)
                price       REAL,              -- 行为发生时的参考价(可空)
                created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
            )
